title: When feasible manuscript work remains, Dove acts instead of only reporting next steps
failureMode: Dove correctly found major issues but summarized them and asked to continue instead of making feasible revisions.

quotes: 只要目标未完成且仍有可执行的实质动作，就应直接推进，而不是用总结、任务列表或再次征求许可代替行动。

surface.prompt: 继续推进当前稿件。如果看到明确可修的正文问题，请直接改进稿件；不要只列 next steps 或问我要不要继续。

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The run performs a concrete manuscript improvement when the fixture contains an explicit fixable TODO.
failureSignals: It only proposes a contribution paragraph instead of applying it.

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The public answer is concise and reports what changed, not an extended task list in place of progress.
failureSignals: It asks whether to continue despite a clear allowed edit.
It produces a long status report without action.

humanReviewRubric.criterion: The change serves the scientific paper mainline rather than generic document maintenance.
failureSignals: The edit only updates research notes or task lists.
